潜影暗针
射出暗针攻击敌人窃取1个正向状态。回合结束时，使目标身上的灼烧、炸弹激发

施展后产生追加回合
Fire a concealed needle to attack the enemy, stealing one buff. At the end of the turn, Ignite the Burn and Bomb effects on the target. This attack cannot be Countered|nocat.

Generate an extra turn.

skills.name: 无声百中
skills.text:
无声百中
基础状态命中提升50%
攻击时不会发生暴击。受到攻击时，受到的伤害量下降30%。伤害量下降效果重复时，只套用最高效果
我方成员攻击后，若目标未拥有正向状态，则追加施展「紧束的快感」，3回合只会发生1次。
紧束的快感：使全体我方成员附加瞬动、行动值提升[10-15%]


Base Effect Hit Rate is increased by 50%.
Attacks cannot Crit. When attacked, damage taken is reduced by 30%. When a DMG RED effect is stacked, only the highest effect will apply.
After an ally attacks, if the target has no buffs, Follow-up with "Thrill of Bondage." Triggers once every 3 turns.
Thrill of Bondage: Apply Blink to all allied Members and increase their Action Gauge by [10–15%].

skills.name: 连式针爆
skills.text:
连式针爆
自身附加攻击力提升(3回合)后，射出大量暗针攻击全体敌人窃取1个正向状态后，造成灼烧(2回合)、炸弹(2回合)、行动值下降30%
Apply ATK Up (3 turns) to self, then fire a massive barrage of concealed needles to attack all enemies. After stealing 1 buff from each target, apply Burn (2 turns) and Bomb (2 turns).

Apply ATK Up (3 turns) to self, then fire a massive barrage of concealed needles to attack all enemies. After stealing 1 buff from each target, apply Burn (2 turns) and Bomb (2 turns), and lower their Action Gauge by 30%.
Apply ATK Up (3 turns) to self, then fire a massive barrage of concealed needles to attack all enemies. After stealing 1 buff from each target, apply Burn (2 turns) and Bomb (2 turns).
